1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void, wherein the filler comprises __a reinforcing material selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __wherein the adhesive layer comprises a structural adhesive that is distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape of the first, second and third members__.

2. (Previously presented)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Original)

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, __and wherein the adhesive layer is applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and wherein the offset is created by intentional placement of the fabric layers rather than by wrinkles or deformation in the laminated composite tape__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone, __wherein the reinforcing member comprises a material selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive layer comprises a structural adhesive that is distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape of the channels and base__.

8. (Original)

9. (Original)

10. (Original)

11. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, __and__ a titanium member.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein the patches are applied as distinct layers separate from the laminated composite tape of the channels and base__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape__, and wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape and the base is formed from laminated composite tape, __and wherein the structural adhesive layer is applied as a separate layer distinct from the resin matrix of the laminated composite tape__.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a pair of channels, each including radius areas between the web and the flanges, and a cap and a base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels, cap and base in the radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone, __wherein the reinforcing filler comprises a material selected from the group consisting of a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape__.
